title: wire claim_seq replay gate into lichen_slot_coord_process_claim
description: Child 2 of nwjl.4 decomposition (Zephyr C). Wire slot_claim_seq_load/store (child 1, project-LICHEN-worker6-nwjl.4 decomposition) into lichen_slot_coord_process_claim (coap_slot_coord.c:290-341) after signature verify and expiry check, BEFORE conflict resolution (:341-365): if claim_seq <= cached -> new enum LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_REPLAY (coap_slot_coord.h:83-93, value 5) -> 4.03 Forbidden at the resource (:1013-1024 mapping). On accept path, store new high-water BEFORE registering the gateway (:367-376) - persist-first: a burned seq only forces the legitimate sender to increment (spec :219); apply-then-persist reopens the replay window on crash-between. Add replay-gate test with stale seq then fresh seq.
